auth.title: Log in
auth.displayName: Name (as written in the shift table)
auth.resetSent: Email sent. Please open the link in the email.
auth.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation email. Open the link in it, then log in.

pending.title: Waiting for approval
pending.body: You can use the app after a manager approves you. Please enter your name.

privacy.title: About your personal data
privacy.body1: Records in this app (meeting records and patrol checks) are used to improve customer service and to pay patrol time.
privacy.body2: Only company managers can see the records. Do not enter customer information. Photos and videos are saved in the company’s Google Drive. Do not film customers’ faces. Text written in other languages is sent to an external translation service (Anthropic) to be translated into Japanese.
privacy.body3: Records are used only inside the company and are not deleted.
